nodes.label: logo-light.svg light-mode branding logo
nodes.description: 1080x174 SVG light-mode brand mark for welcome page. Layout: left icon cluster plus right wordmark inside clipped group. Components: red geometric mark (#F44250 interlocking rounded shape), three black circular dots (#121212), small uppercase eyebrow text spelling REACT, large wordmark letterforms spelling ROUTER with leading R. Purpose: light-theme product branding logo displayed on welcome page.
